svg.title: OpenCodeReview — my open-source contributions
svg.desc: OpenCodeReview. Human contributor rank #6 / 162. I assess the rationale, feasibility, and scope of proposed changes. I review pull requests for security vulnerabilities, robustness, and failure handling. I develop Subversion (SVN) support on my personal branch, separate from upstream. I validate and fix data-handling vulnerabilities, boundary-condition errors, and overflow issues.
